Phil

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Error message in two-tier model
parts:
The two-tier crashing problem has been patched on the latest dev, version 1.2.3. Feel free to check it out. Also, you likely will get better results if you increase the quadrature number to 15 or more, since 9 is a bit on the low end for good accuracy (this was in the example file just for speed reasons, not accuracy). Cheers.

Phil
